preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(k, int) and 1 <= k < n <= 200000 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (rooms) and k (friends) are integers satisfying 1 <= k < n <= 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(friends) == k and all(2 <= x <= n for x in friends) and len(set(friends)) == k for friends in friend_lists)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the list of friend positions has length k, all positions are between 2 and n, and all positions are distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges) for n, edges in zip(n_values, edge_lists))
preconditions.description: For each test case, there are exactly n-1 edges, and each edge connects two valid room numbers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(is_tree(n, edges) for n, edges in zip(n_values, edge_lists))
preconditions.description: The graph formed by rooms and corridors is a connected undirected tree for each test case.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and (line == '-1' or line.isdigit()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either the string '-1' or a string representing a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all((int(output_lines[i]) == -1) == (not exists_winning_subset(n_values[i], friend_lists[i], edge_lists[i])) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output is -1 if and only if no subset of friends can guarantee catching Vlad before he reaches a leaf node other than room 1.

postconditions.expression: all((int(output_lines[i]) == min_subset_size(n_values[i], friend_lists[i], edge_lists[i])) if exists_winning_subset(n_values[i], friend_lists[i], edge_lists[i]) else True for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i where a winning subset exists, the output is the minimum number of friends required to guarantee catching Vlad.
